observations: Three photos show a home theatre system with two tall black tower speakers, a central black unit with a DVD player on top, and a subwoofer at the front.
The central unit has a visible DVD logo on the front panel.
The speakers have two visible drivers each, with a larger one at the bottom and a smaller one above.
The subwoofer is rectangular, black, and positioned in front of the central unit.
The setup is placed on a tiled floor against a white wall with visible wear and a hanging cable on the left.
All photos are nearly identical, with slight variations in lighting and angle.
No brand names or model numbers are visible on any component.
The system appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor scuffs.

claims.claim: Neatly used home theatre for 6 months
claims.evidence: No visual proof of usage duration or condition beyond general appearance; photos show dust and minor wear, but no evidence of 6 months of use or 'neat' condition.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a home theatre system, but no brand or model is visible, and the seller's claim of 6 months of neat use is unverified. Critical risks include functionality and completeness, which cannot be assessed from current photos. Proof is needed to determine if the system works and what components are included.
